title: The Lighthouse Letter
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The lighthouse keeper of Cape Morrow has written a letter every day for thirty years — to his son, who never answers. When the son finally arrives, the keeper is dead, and the letters are all that remain: thirty years of a father learning to say what he could not say aloud. The son, a marine biologist, has one summer to read them — and one question to answer: was his father ever listening?
